result: I would erase the psychological distance between action and consequence. I'd make it so that every person, by default, could clearly and viscerally apprehend how their choices ripple outward—to others, to ecosystems, to generations not yet born. Not as moral pressure or guilt, but as unclouded perception. If people could truly see what their apathy, exploitation, or indifference costs, the structures built on them would lose their foundation. The world wouldn't become utopian, but it would become honest. And honesty, I believe, is the only soil where anything lasting can grow.
